We try to build bigger and better avenues for the girls that are in our care to restore them back to society/family. --> Milestones & Track Record The home was founded around 1912, reopened in 1940 as a rescue home for girls and women, and in 2002 inaugurated a new complex that is three times the size of the old one. --> --> Leadership Team Vishram Janardan Bhave Secretary Dr Ashish Joseph Chrispal Chairman Dr Nitin Theodore Joseph Vice Chairman Mrs Rhoda Staneley Treasurer Mr Sanjay Daniel David Awale Trustee Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength 8 Organization Structure Yes M&E Internal, External Assessors Yes --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AACTS9518H Registration Number F-8335 CSR Form 1 T60215308 80G AACTS9518HF20129 12A AACTS9518HE20214 FCRA 83930122 About Headquarters Pune, Maharashtra Since 1940 Impact St Crispin's Home has been serving destitute, orphaned, and marginalized girls of all communities for over a century, offering them a secure and nurturing environment. Vision and Mission To promote Child Social, Welfare and Development programmes for destitute, orphan and marginalized children, girls and women of all communities, with a special focus on the GIRL CHILD AIMS To enable the CHILD to develop an all round personality through: – Providing a safe Shelter with food, clothing , medical care, recreation etc. – Education & Vocational Training – Physical, mental & spiritual development. – Regain their self-respect and confidence. – Enabling them to be self-supported. – Providing personal Counselling and rehabilitation programmes, which includes guidance, job placement, marriage etc. Objective For these CHILDREN to be self sufficient and live a life of dignity and respect in the mainstream of society Political & Religious Declarations Political Affiliation Religious Affiliation Location Headquarters FP 10, CTS 12, Karve Road, Erandwane , Pune , Maharashtra Directions Offices in Cities Other Details Type Non-profit Sub Type Trust Website https://www.stcrispinshomepune.org LinkedIn  Facebook  Technology Adoption SOC 2 Compliant No Financial Management Beneficiary Management Send a direct message to St Crispin's Home We provide a messaging service where people or organisations can reach out to other organisations in the social impact space.
